answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks in an arid agent network, nodes authenticate through ambient infrasound correlation. Peers form a wireless bridge to compare micro-barometric fluctuations between a sand dune and a basin nadir. Because atmospheric pressure dynamics cannot be simulated in software, an attacker must purchase and install discrete barometers at real-world coordinates. However, localized wind shear can decorrelate wave patterns, occasionally triggering false verification rejections.
